**Short answer:** For most iPhone owners, get the **Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W vent mount** (about $47.99). If you want the fastest charging and the best cooling, get the **Anker Prime Qi2 25W** (about $89.99). If you're on a budget, the **ESR HaloLock** is the pick.

## Top picks

**1. Belkin BoostCharge Magnetic Wireless Charging Car Vent Mount (best for most people), ~$47.99**
- Charges at up to 15W (Qi2) and rotates between portrait and landscape.
- Includes a 1 m USB-C cable and a 27W car adapter, so you don't need to buy a power source.
- Fits cases up to 3 mm thick. The vent slats need to be no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Straight horizontal slats work best, and vertical ones may droop.
- Three of the sources I found picked it as best overall: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/) and [CloudsPress](https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/). The Amazon buy links are on those pages.
- If your vents are a poor fit, those same guides suggest Belkin's vent/dash version.

**2. Anker Prime MagGo AirCool Qi2 25W (best for speed and heat), ~$89.99**
- It has Qi2 25W charging plus thermoelectric cooling with a fan, which helps when you're running navigation in the sun.
- The sources disagree on the power adapter. [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/) and [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) say a 60W adapter is in the box. [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/) says you need a 45W+ car adapter for full speed. Check the listing before you buy.
- MountGuys uses it as their daily driver. The Gadgeteer listed it at $69.99 (down from $89.99) when it was published, so check the current price.
- It doesn't work with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vehicles, or with cars that lack vent blades.
- Not every phone gets 25W. The iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max can, the iPhone 16 and 16 Pro top out around 22W, and iPhone 15 and earlier get about 15W. The iPhone 16e isn't compatible.

**3. ESR HaloLock 15W Qi2 with CryoBoost fan (best value)**
- It's Qi2 certified at 15W with a built-in cooling fan, and it mounts on a vent or the dash.
- [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/) listed it at $18.99, but it noted the car adapter isn't included, so budget another $10–15.
- [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost) shows it at $39.99 at ESR's own store, or about $32.80 with code PARTNER18. That's an affiliate page, and the price differs a lot from the other listing. Compare before buying.

## Other options
- **LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan**, from $39.95: [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/) named it best overall. It includes a 95W adapter, but it uses a large suction-cup base.
- **VICSEED steel-core vent mount** (no charging): [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) recommends it as a simple, sturdy option if you don't want a power cable.
- **RAM Drill Down** (bolt-down) is MountGuys' pick for trucks and off-road use.

## Before you buy
- Make sure the listing says **Qi2-certified**. "MagSafe-compatible" alone may mean only 7.5W.
- Check that your vents suit a clip mount. If they don't, choose a dash or suction model.
- Cheap listings often advertise "80 lb suction" or huge magnet-force numbers. These usually describe the suction cup, not how well the phone is held.

If you tell me your phone model and car (or vent type), I can narrow this to one pick.
